title: Panthers GM Dan Morgan: There's no rule against taking a WR in first round three straight years

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Panthers GM Dan Morgan: There's no rule against taking a WR in first round three straight years
sources.description: The Panthers visited with some of the top wide receiver prospects in this year's draft class and those meetings have led to questions about whether they will actually use a first-round pick on a wideout for the third straight season.
